source.source_family: Adopted Local Plan residential site allocation / official polygon GIS layer
source.data_date_basis: The public Bromley Site Allocations GIS layer records a data last edit date of 3 January 2024; the Local Plan itself was adopted on 16 January 2019.
source.license: London Borough of Bromley public planning-policy and GIS service; layer-specific reuse licence not stated in the public service metadata
source.source_geometry_availability: Bromley's public Site Allocations layer 45 is an esriGeometryPolygon feature layer with sitename/sitereference fields. Exact Bromley Civic Centre feature extraction and canonical parcel spatial join are delegated to local OpenCode.
source.source_file_sha256_reason: The official Local Plan web page and ArcGIS service metadata were accessed through public web transport; raw Local Plan PDF bytes and the exact feature response bytes were not acquired, so no source-file hash is fabricated.

canonical_join: not performed; local OpenCode spatial join/materialization required
